def cond(L):
    mask=(1<<64)-1
    rdx=(L*0xf4243) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+0x17) & mask
    rdx=(rdx*rdx) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+6) & mask
    rdx=(rdx*0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeef) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+0xbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb) & mask
    return rdx
rax=0x1111111111111110
vals=[]
for L in range(0,500):
    rdx=cond(L)
    if rax>=rdx:
        vals.append((L,rdx))
print('count',len(vals))
print(vals[:40])
print('max L', max([L for L,_ in vals]) if vals else None)

target = bytes.fromhex('6b3ffe473cad5fe660cf8824a947fe7411860f5993e36e')
assert len(target)==23
edx=0x2d
out=[]
for i,t in enumerate(target):
    # condition: (edx ^ c) & 0xff == t
    c = (edx & 0xff) ^ t
    out.append(c)
    edx = (edx + c) & 0xffffffff
print('bytes:', out)
print('ascii:', bytes(out))
# also show printable with escapes
print('repr:', bytes(out).__repr__())
